description: Fetch the latest data from one of the caller's connected platforms (Google Search Console, Shopify, Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4 and more) now and report per report what arrived. It never changes settings or the login, and runs at most once per connector per 10 minutes.

connector_id.description: The id of the connector instance to refresh (from my_workspace action "connectors").

name: refresh_connector
